name: Meridian Munitions Compact Rifle MCR-2 'Errand'
description:
The MCR-2 Errand is Meridian Munitions' ultracompact assault rifle, designed for couriers, drivers, and operators who need a rifle that disappears into a messenger bag. With the stock folded, the weapon measures 380mm overall — shorter than most submachine guns — yet fires the same 6mm caseless round as the larger MM-4 Breadwinner. Magazine compatibility between the two weapons is deliberate, allowing operators to standardize on a single ammunition type across their primary and backup weapons.

The Errand sacrifices barrel length for concealability, which reduces effective range to 250 meters and increases muzzle flash and report. A compact suppressor threaded to the barrel adds 120mm but brings both signatures down to manageable levels. The BCI aim-assist system is particularly valuable on the MCR-2, where the short sight radius would otherwise make iron-sight accuracy challenging.

Meridian markets the Errand as a vehicle defense weapon and personal protection rifle, but its concealability makes it popular with operators who need to carry a rifle where rifles aren't welcome. In Tier 2-3 zones with weapons checkpoints, the MCR-2 passes for electronics equipment in a sufficiently cluttered bag.
specifications:
caliber: 6mm caseless
effective_range: 250m (unsuppressed), 220m (suppressed)
rate_of_fire: 750 rpm (cyclic)
magazine_capacity: 35 rounds (MM-4 compatible)
weight: 2.4 kg
tactical_use: The MCR-2 fills the gap between a submachine gun and a full-size rifle. Its rifle-caliber round provides better terminal performance than pistol-caliber PDWs while its compact dimensions allow concealed carry in civilian environments. The suppressed configuration is a favorite of covert operators who need to engage targets without advertising their position. Magazine commonality with the MM-4 simplifies logistics for teams carrying both platforms.
cultural_context: The Errand is the weapon of people who go places. Couriers, fixers, negotiators, and anyone whose job involves moving through spaces where visible weapons invite trouble. Its name reflects its intended user — someone running errands in dangerous territory who needs insurance that fits in a shoulder bag. In freelancer circles, drawing an MCR-2 from a messenger bag has become a cliched movie move, but it works.
story_hooks: A courier's MCR-2 was scanned at a weapons checkpoint that supposedly couldn't detect the weapon — the scanner operator is taking bribes, but from whom?
Someone has been planting MCR-2s in dead drops across a Tier 3 zone. The weapons are clean, loaded, and positioned at locations that suggest a planned coordinated attack.
related_entities: Vespid Dynamics Pheromone Marker Gun PMG-1 'Breadwinner'

physical_description.visual_profile: A deliberately compact, almost skeletal assault rifle with aggressive minimalism. The folded profile resembles a submachine gun crossed with a precision instrument—all sharp angles and purposeful geometry. The design emphasizes function over aesthetics; every curve and edge serves concealment or performance.
physical_description.dimensions: 380mm overall length (stock folded), 520mm (stock extended); 65mm width across receiver; 120mm height at charging handle. Barrel length 180mm. Suppressor adds 120mm when threaded.
physical_description.weight_description: Lightweight and balanced despite its compact form—feels almost hollow in the hand. Controllable during sustained fire, but front-heavy when suppressed. Noticeably less substantial than full-size rifles, which contributes to its appeal as a 'invisible' weapon.
physical_description.primary_material: Hybrid polymer-aluminum frame with reinforced composite lower receiver and steel barrel. Polymer components are injection-molded reinforced thermoplastic; aluminum is 6061-T6 alloy.
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal polymer on receiver and handguard; brushed natural aluminum on exposed frame rails and charging handle. Barrel exhibits light oxidation patina suggesting field use. Suppressor is blackened steel with minimal reflectivity.
physical_description.color_scheme: Predominantly matte black and dark charcoal with brushed silver/aluminum accents. No vibrant colors; designed to avoid visual attention.
physical_description.grip_texture: Rubberized, slightly tacky polymer grip with shallow finger grooves. Textured to prevent slipping in wet conditions. The folding stock area is bare aluminum where the grip interface transitions.
distinctive_features: Aggressive folding stock mechanism with visible locking lugs
Top-mounted Picatinny rail running full length of receiver with integrated BCI aim-assist mount
Threaded muzzle with distinctive rapid-detach suppressor coupling
Recessed magazine well showing magazine compatibility indexing marks
Charging handle positioned far forward to maintain compact profile
Dual-stage safety selector with engraved icons barely visible under field grime
Heat-dissipation vents along polymer handguard showing internal ribbing
Serial number etched microscopically along lower receiver edge
Faint wear marks on grip from repeated draw and manipulation
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: MERIDIAN MUNITIONS block-letter logo stamped on both sides of lower receiver near magazine well. Model designation 'MCR-2' and 'ERRAND' printed in small sans-serif font on receiver rail. 'CASELESS 6MM' stamped near chamber. Meridian's stylized 'M' stamp on suppressor coupling nut.
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained but field-worn. Light scratches on polymer from bag carry, minor oxidation on exposed aluminum, suppressor showing carbon bloom around the muzzle. Weapon appears functional and regularly used rather than safe-queen pristine.
